story: 從雙白線起點到橋頭約 85 m:前 35 m 是實線(不准變道),後 50 m 是槽化線(漸變);右側整段是紅線、溝蓋帶,66 m 起又多了擋牆。機車在這 85 m 裡要同時閃右側違停/溝蓋和左側縮減。 和 2024-09 施工中相比,實線起點往回提早了約 40 m(35–50),槽化線起點提早約 13 m;2022-11 開工當月這裡還是雙向道,兩者都不存在。

drain_covers.method: Street View every 8 m from 0 to 88 m, camera turned to the gutter (heading 176, pitch -40), 2025-06 imagery except 8/48/64 m which snapped to 2022-11/2024-09 panoramas. A Gabor bar-texture x local-darkness detector proposed boxes; a bar-periodicity test rejected round covers. Each grate is placed at its panorama's along_m plus its apparent distance ahead; the near grate of each panorama is counted once. Final list read by eye against the detector's boxes.
drain_covers.detector_record: isolation/grate_detections_2026-09-22.md. On Street View the detector confirmed 5 of the 7 (missed 16 m under a parked car and 44 m at the frame edge; one false box each on a scooter at 40 m and a rider at 88 m). On the phone frames the bar-periodicity test INVERTED at one-third resolution - it rejected the real grates (scores 5-6) and kept the round covers (7-11) - so the phone count is not used.
drain_covers.reading: seven grated inlets between the double white line's start and the bridge head, at roughly 8, 16, 28, 44, 58, 74 and 82 m; the rider's seven.
